environment.description: Same Laravel 10.x application on PHP 8.2 FPM, ECS Fargate (2 vCPU, 4GB RAM), PostgreSQL 15 RDS with pgBouncer transaction pooling and prepared statement query parameterization. PHP runtime configured with pcre.backtrack_limit=100000 and pcre.recursion_limit=50000 via php.ini override in container image. Additionally, the ECS task definition includes an Envoy sidecar proxy (AWS App Mesh) with a 3-second per-route request timeout on all /api/search* paths, and the container runs with a seccomp profile restricting clock_nanosleep and nanosleep syscalls to prevent CPU spin loops from consuming full time slices. pgBouncer server_idle_timeout set to 5s with max_client_conn=50 and default_pool_size=10.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB, AWS App Mesh with Envoy sidecar
